plate_findings.evidence: A ventriculo-arterial discordance with the pulmonary trunk arising from the left ventricle

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Fetal B-mode 3-vessel view showing the pulmonary trunk arising from the left ventricle with ventriculo-arterial discordance, the defining echocardiographic feature of D-TGA, in a fetus from an article focused on D-TGA. Annotated labels (LV, RV, TP, LPA, RPA, Ao) confirm the anatomy. B: Fetal B-mode 3-vessel view in a D-TGA fetus showing a restrictive arterial duct (arrow marks ductal size). The ductal size is a routinely assessed feature in this D-TGA cohort; the finding is not in the vocabulary, so it is captured as a proposed finding. C: Color Doppler 3-vessel view in the same D-TGA fetus showing antegrade flow through the restrictive arterial duct, a routinely assessed ductal flow feature in this cohort. Not in the vocabulary, so recorded as a proposed finding.
